item.title: PlayStation Store: January 2026s top downloads
item.description: Raiding and free-to-play battles topped the charts in January.

item.title: UK games industry to receive dedicated SIC codes for development and publishing
item.description: New classifications will "allow the government, investors, and policymakers to properly understand the industry's economic impact," says UKIE.

item.title: Could Indie Developers Save Parasite Eve
item.description: Three indie projects influenced by Parasite Eve are in the works, and a strong reception could motivate Square Enix to bring the series back.

item.title: The First Screenshot for Evangelion: Cross Reflections Arrives
item.description: It's not much to go on, but the first screenshot for Evangelion: Cross Reflections, the upcoming VR game based on the anime, has arrived.

item.title: Metroid Prime 4 Surpasses One Million Sales
item.description: Nintendo confirms Metroid Prime 4: Beyond has sold over one million copies across Switch and Switch 2 combined.

item.title: Overwatch Spotlight: The Reign of Talon Begins
item.description: Welcome to a new era. Follow the first fully-connected narrative arc in Overwatch history, play five new Heroes in Season 1, and enjoy expansive gameplay updates when Vendettas reign begins on Feb. 10.

item.title: Report: Marathon Ranked Mode Details Surface About Scoring, Holotags and More
item.description: MP1st has managed to obtain early info on Marathon's ranked mode details such as scoring, Holotags and more.

item.title: Battlefield 6 "Exceeded Expectations" According to EA
item.description: Electronic Arts has said that Battlefield 6 has "exceeded expectations," which is good news for franchise fans.

item.title: Microsoft Targeting Halo PS5 Release in the Summer
item.description: Microsoft is planning to put out Halo: Campaign Evolved on PS5 during the summer months, according to a new report from The Verge covering Xbox's plans for 2026.

item.title: Sony Discusses Plans to Mitigate RAM Shortage for PS5, Cheaper PlayStation for Japan, and More
item.description: Today, during Sony's quarterly conference call, CFO Lin Tao offered more color on the PlayStation business and the plans for PS5.
